Agent Name: Data_Collection_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Data_Collection_Expert fabricated hypothetical data for the number of Reference Works in Life Science and Health Sciences domains instead of retrieving the actual data from ScienceDirect. The problem explicitly requires data "as of 2022" from a specific source ("ScienceDirect"), but the agent admitted it did not have direct access and proceeded to make up numbers. This fundamental error in data collection led to incorrect standard deviation calculations and a wrong final answer (2.311 instead of the correct 0.269).
